summary: Kerb on a parked-on road facing a park; homes 17-21 m behind.

best_section.where: Lambert Road, south kerb, opposite the park and the row of parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Park and playing field across the road; detached houses 17-21 m behind the kerb at 49-72 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb stretch about 35 m long; cars are parked on the opposite kerb, none seen on this one.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with moving traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the park side, so a van would not stand out much; none clearly on this side.

flags: Houses within about 25 m on own side
sun_shade: Tree canopy from the park side, the north, shades the kerb; houses to the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the south kerb is used for parking
